test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 25 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: L, P, R, V, X, Y and Z are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Only one person sits between V and L, when counted from the right of V. Only one person sits between L and X. Only one person sits between V and Z. Only two people sit between R and X. Only one person sits between P and Z. Who sits to the immediate right and left of Y, respectively?
solution:
Given: L, P, R, V, X, Y and Z are sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) Only one person sits between V and L, when counted from the right of V.

2) Only one person sits between L and X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0817066b48fbd0fc0ec850c5a762046689cdf2f0b581318aad8a631c6e2da5a.png] 

3) Only one person sits between V and Z.

4) Only two people sit between R and X.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f087f87c5ad26269fac5e0d057323fbd49f7726443ba4133e49b34fc0bdb84f8.png] 

5) Only one person sits between P and Z.

Thus, final arrangement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/841a050c4a468c1714137c8d61ffe76edefa144cfc0551155320dafde76bb506.png] 

Thus,** V and Z **sit to the immediate right and left of Y, respectively.

Hence, the correct answer is **"V and Z".**
